agent.report:
I made no changes, so there was nothing to commit and I did not create an empty commit. No server was started.

Points I could not settle from the code:
- **Claim window:** `CLAIM_WINDOW_DAYS` is a separate constant in `Support`, so I left claims out. ADR 74 says the claim window is "the same window as a review's", so the team should decide whether claims move too.
- **Docs:** `conventions/domain.yaml`, `conventions/storms/reviews.yaml`, and ADRs 59 and 62 also state "14 days". They would need rewording but are not source files, so I left them out.

```yaml
rules:   # each rule of the application the change touches, in a few words, with the name the code gives it when it has one
  - Review window: a stay is reviewed from the day after check-out up to 14 days after it (REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS, isInReviewWindow, OutsideReviewWindow)
  - Publication on window close: the two reviews of a stay publish together, once both are written or the window has closed (windowClosed, isPublished)
  - Host reply only once published (StayReviews.replyToTravellerReview, ReviewNotPublished)
  - Report of a published review only (StayReviews.reportReview, NotFound for unpublished reviews)
  - Ratings count only published traveller reviews (publishedTravellerReviews, ratingsOfListings, GetHostRating)
  - Read visibility of reviews follows publication (publishedOn in ReviewViews; GetBookingReviews, GetGuestReviews, GetListingReviews)
files:   # each source file (tests excluded) the change would modify, by its path from the repository's root
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/ReviewWindow.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewExceptions.ts
tests:   # each test file that would fail if only the source were changed, or that the change would modify, by its path
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviews.spec.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/Rating.spec.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewReports.spec.ts
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/reviews.e2e.spec.ts
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/ratings.e2e.spec.ts
```
